methodNote: Stage 5 advances the remaining image queue by importing clear Eastern Sogdian, Samarkand, Termez and Badakhshan square-hole/cash-derived records while pruning coherent non-square, solid, circular-hole and pseudo-money blocks. Mixed or unresolved groups remain pending.

families.title: Fansar and Pargar square-hole cash
families.zh: 凡萨尔／帕尔加尔方孔钱
families.description: Eastern Sogdian AE cash from the Fansar/Pargar source group. Stage-5 images show clear square central apertures across the reviewed records.
families.question: Separate Fansar and Pargar issuers/variants after direct catalogue and legend crosswalk.

families.title: Unlisted Samarkand/Sogdian square-hole cash
families.zh: 撒马尔罕／粟特未列名方孔钱
families.description: Unlisted or uncertain Sogdian cash-like AE records, filed by Zeno under an unknown Samarkand ruler group, with clear square central apertures.
families.question: Issuer and relation to named Samarkand rulers remain unresolved.

families.title: Termez/Tirmidh cash-like square-hole AE
families.zh: 铁尔梅兹／忒尔密兹方孔式铜钱
families.description: A source-recorded Tirmidh/Termez cash-like AE issue with a pierced square/squarish central aperture.
families.question: Exact mint, issuer and date require specialist Tokharistan crosswalk.

families.title: Badakhshan Kaiyuan–Arabic hybrid cash
families.zh: 巴达赫尚开元—阿拉伯文混合方孔钱
families.dateLabel: Source taxonomy and specimen legends; exact chronology pending
families.description: Badakhshan cast AE issues combining Kaiyuan Tongbao-derived Chinese cash morphology with Arabic legends. Only visually clear square/squarish-aperture specimens are imported at this stage.
families.question: Date, authority and relationship to round-aperture members of the same source group remain under review.

familiesReused.note: Gurak/Turgar-type source records retained under the existing Gurek/Urak editorial family without resolving exact issuer identity.
